jobs.title: $22.50HR/ RETAIL STORES UNARMED SECURITY OFFICER SEASONAL WORK STRTS SEPT
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Unarmed Security Officer to uphold safety and security across our premises. In this dynamic role, you will be the first line of defense, ensuring a secure environment through proactive surveillance, access control, and customer service. Your presence will help maintain order, prevent incidents, and foster a safe atmosphere for staff, visitors, and property. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security expertise while contributing to a safe community.

Duties

  • Monitor surveillance systems such as CCTV to detect suspicious activity and ensure property security.
  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises, including buildings, parking lots, and restricted areas to identify potential security threats.
  • Control access points using access control systems, verifying identities and authorizations of employees, visitors, and contractors.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations following established procedures, including fire alarms or medical emergencies.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual occurrences for record-keeping and future reference.
  • Perform background checks on new personnel or visitors as part of security screening processes.
  • Assist with conflict de-escalation and conflict management to maintain a peaceful environment while adhering to security regulations.

Skills

  • Strong surveillance skills with experience operating CCTV and other monitoring equipment.
  • Knowledge of law enforcement procedures and emergency response protocols.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks safely, including heavy lifting when necessary.
  • Excellent customer service skills with a professional demeanor when interacting with the public.
  • Proficiency in incident report writing with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as Taser devices (non-lethal), AEDs (Automated External Defibrillators), and fire extinguishers.
  • Understanding of physical security measures including patrolling techniques and access control systems.
  • Ability to perform first aid procedures including CPR and AED operation confidently.
  • Experience in performing background checks and ensuring compliance with security regulations.
  • Strong conflict de-escalation skills combined with effective communication for conflict management situations.

Join us as a Unarmed Security Officer and become an integral part of maintaining a safe, secure environment where safety is our top priority!

Embark on this seasonal journey where your expertise makes a real difference! We value energetic professionals committed to safety and community well-being. Join us in creating a secure environment that allows everyone to enjoy the festivities confidently.

Pay: Up to $45.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Security Officer - Retail Supervisor
jobs.description:
GardaWorld Security Services is Now Hiring a Surveillance Security Officer!

Ready to suit up as a Surveillance Security Guard?

What matters most about a role like this is your sharp eye, capturing every detail as you scan a series of screens. Tell us about your strong observation skills with attention to detail.

As a Security Officer – Surveillance, you will be the person spotting threats before they escalate in environments such as a security operations centers, call centers, parking gatehouses, etc.

What’s in it for you:

  • Site Location: Houston, Tx
  • Set schedule: Full-time Saturday-Wednesday 2pm-10pm
  • Competitive hourly wage of $20.00/hr (DailyPay is available for GardaWorld employees!)
  • A comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer matching contributions, paid time off (PTO) policy, paid holidays, disability coverage, and life insurance options
  • Career growth opportunities at GardaWorld
  • Uniform provided at no cost

Responsibilities of Surveillance Security Guard

  • Must have 1+ years of Verifiable Supervisor Experience
  • Monitor security systems to detect any suspicious activity
  • Document observed events and incidents, writing detailed reports
  • Respond quickly to incidents or potential threats
  • Conduct regular patrols to ensure the safety of the premises
  • Control access to secure areas and verify the identities of visitors
  • Analyze security systems to identify potential vulnerabilities or malfunctions
  • Collaborate with law enforcement in case of serious situations or emergencies
  • Ensure the safety and protection of individuals and property

Qualifications of a Surveillance Security Guard

  • Be authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Be able to provide documentation of High School Diploma or GED
  • Be able to ace (and pass) an extensive screening process
  • Strong report writing skills
  • Sharp visual activity and exceptional concentration skills
  • Strong proficiency with technology
  • If you have Security, Military, Law Enforcement experience – even better!
  • You have a state license if required

In the United States, GardaWorld Security remains the only guarding security company to be Certified by Great Place to Work. Apply today – this could be more than a job! 26% of our corporate employees started as frontline workers.

If you’re ambitious with an entrepreneurial spirit – someone who wants to be a GardaWorld Ambassador – a promising career awaits you!

GardaWorld Security is a global champion in sophisticated and tailored security solutions, employing and training highly skilled and dedicated professionals across the globe.

Not the job for you? Make sure to check out all our jobs! We also have tactical, concierge, and even casual roles available.

Employment is contingent on the successful completion of a background check and drug screening to be conducted after an offer of employment is extended.
